chunks: He will send you abundant rain from the sky,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God sends rain from the sky in abundance?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Nuh, this verse highlights the tangible manifestation of divine mercy through abundant rainfall, serving as a physical sign of God's power to sustain life. Shia exegetes often view this as a dual blessing—both spiritual and material—offered to Noah's people as a test of their gratitude and faith in the monotheistic message.
